items.q: It seems to me I've seen write ups in jazz anthologies referring to Baby and Julia out there with Benny Carter and Vic Dickenson.

ctx.x: Yeah, Capitol. That would be in the mid-forties, wouldn't it? About '46, '47. It seems to me I've seen write ups in jazz anthologies referring to Baby and Julia out there with Benny Carter and Vic Dickenson.
It was back in the forties.
